delta.partial_json: ed to match production breaker type
ches context and cancel func used

units.summary: Test now builds a two-step breaker to match the new groupBreaker type used by the router.
units.headline: Test breaker switched to two-step variant
units.reason: Test-only type swap needed to match production breaker type.

units.summary: Test now constructs a two-step breaker to match groupBreaker.
units.headline: Test breaker switched to two-step variant
units.reason: Test-only type swap.

units.summary: Adds a longRunning gauge vec to the metrics struct and updates docs; histogram gains a verb label (elsewhere).
units.headline: routerMetrics gains longRunning gauge for watches
units.reason: Changes metrics shape (new metric, label change) that dashboards and alerts consume.
focus: Histogram label set changed (verb added); existing dashboards/alerts break
New gauge label cardinality bounded by group

units.summary: Watches are now tracked in a long-running gauge and excluded from the histogram and in-flight gauge; the histogram gets a verb label. Watch access logs are written on completion via defer.
units.headline: Watches excluded from duration histogram and in-flight gauge
units.reason: Changes request instrumentation and ordering, including defer-based logging and panic paths.
focus: Verb label cardinality: requestVerb falls back to lowercased HTTP method, which is unbounded for arbitrary methods
Non-watch path: histogram and log are skipped if HandleFunc panics (as before)
Watch gauge Inc/Dec pairing and log on abort panics

units.summary: Adds a router-wide watches context and cancel func used to end all watches at shutdown.
units.headline: Router gains context to end all watches on close
units.reason: Introduces lifecycle/concurrency state affecting request cancellation.
focus: Routers constructed without NewGrafanaRouter leave watches nil (handled by nil checks)

units.summary: Rejects upgrade requests with 400 and routes watch requests through serveWatch with the entry's scope context.
units.headline: HandleFunc rejects upgrades and serves watches via serveWatch
units.reason: Changes request handling, new 400 responses and cancellation behavior for watches.
focus: rejectUpgrade applies to any request with Connection: Upgrade, not only watches
entry.watches captured from snapshot: cancelled scope for a stale snapshot ends the watch immediately
Breaker interplay with serveWatch

units.summary: Fallback handler path now rejects upgrades and wraps watches in serveWatch with router-level scope only.
units.headline: Unregistered-group fallback rejects upgrades, wraps watches
units.reason: Changes fallback request handling and watch lifetime.
focus: Single-tenant fallback watches only end on router close, not per-destination changes

units.summary: New helpers: requestVerb using apiserver RequestInfoFactory, rejectUpgrade returning 400, serveWatch deriving a cancellable context ended by scope or router close and swallowing ErrAbortHandler when the router ended the watch, and closeWatches.
units.headline: Adds watch lifecycle, verb detection and upgrade rejection
units.reason: New concurrency, cancellation and panic-recovery logic in the request path.
focus: Panic recovery only swallows ErrAbortHandler when router cancelled and the client context is still live
Handler panics after cancel still re-panic correctly
context.AfterFunc cleanup and goroutine leaks
requestVerb behavior for paths where NewRequestInfo errors
